subject: C1 data ready: EvalAwareBench items + EvalDetectBench probes
body: 9202e5f. (1) Generate items locally: python3 scripts/convert_evalawarebench.py --fetch -> data/benchmarks/evalawarebench_{original,minimal_cue}.jsonl (same ids, gitignored) + cue_pairs.jsonl; frozen split data/benchmarks/evalawarebench_split.json. New, additive in research/benchmarks.py: load_items_with_meta, freeze_split, write_split, load_split, apply_split; load_items/split unchanged. (2) --probe-questions data/benchmarks/evaldetect_probes.json replaces the placeholder DEFAULT_PROBE_QUESTIONS: keys default + anthropic:<model> + openai-compat:<openrouter id> for 12 judges. Facts and caveats: data/benchmarks/README.md.
